findings:
🟡 [fresh-bound-rotation-set] MUST-FIX In src/status/runs-watch.js tick(), freshBoundOf is computed on the project-filtered rows, but the bounded rotation in collectRuns/buildRunRows (shared cursor file, dispatch-status --list over the whole manifest dir) spans every live run on the host. With N foreign live runs in the dir (other projects, their watchers absent) a project's rows are re-probed only every ceil((own+N)/cap) ticks while the bound assumes ceil(own/cap), so the plan's 2x slack is consumed at 2 projects and probe_age_s exceeds fresh_bound_s from ~3 projects of live runs onward: confirmed_live drops to 0 and the rows flap to unknown although alive === true. Smallest fix: compute the bound from the pre-filter candidate set (`freshBoundOf(all, interval, enrichCap)` using the `all` rows already in tick, and keep `state.lastAll` for the envelopeFor fallback), or restrict the rotation's liveIds to the watched project; add a runs-watch.test.sh case with foreign live manifests present.
🔵 [heartbeat-stale-volatile-fields] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Heartbeat publishes state.lastRuns, so elapsed_s / probe_age_s / last_event_age_s in the envelope rows freeze at the last change (counts are recomputed each tick and republish on transition, so correctness of counts is unaffected). Excluded: the plan requires heartbeat payload to be byte-identical except published_at; P1b/P1c consumers should derive elapsed from started_at and read only counts, which the mods.md reference already says.
🔵 [repo-identity-fields-ambient-cache] CUT/FOLLOW-UP repo_identity_resolve_fields returns early whenever REPO_IDENTITY_FIELDS is already non-empty, so an exported ambient REPO_IDENTITY_FIELDS would be copied verbatim into a manifest. Nothing exports it today (declare -p across the detach boundary keeps it non-exported). Excluded: no in-scope path produces the condition; a cheap hardening is to key the cache on the resolved dir.
🔵 [probe-observed-at-real-clock] CUT/FOLLOW-UP runs-fields.js records probe observed_at with Date.now() while probe_age_s is measured against the injected nowMs; identical in production (nowMs defaults to Date.now()) and only matters for fake-clock harnesses that drive buildRunRows directly, which none do.
🔵 [changelog-deferred] CUT/FOLLOW-UP No CHANGELOG.md row for the new `status runs` fields/selectors, the watcher and the three new modules; CLAUDE.md and docs/scripts-inventory.md were updated. Excluded: P1d (packaging, version bump, CHANGELOG) is the plan's designated commit for it and is out of this release's scope.
